content: Iesu Orot Matan Fotin auman Irat on Iyawasai
Iesu on nana ibib i’nan ato On iyeit orot matan fotin auman irat on it.
On an baigibubunuotis on sitetemai siyau, “Baibebeotim, iyafan an bokomas emon iyamai on matan fotin auman irat i? On toun an bokomas emon o ayon taman asi bokomas emon?”
Iesu iyafotes iyau, “On matan ifofot on men toun an bokomas emon o ayon taman asi bokomas emon. On matan ifot onai God an faiwar on orot usinai inbobo on sabu sinitai.
Rai wat on ato Iyafan ibiyafareu on an bobo on nana tanabo; ato awa efofom on men iyafan tani bobo inabo on.
Yau nin tafanamai amama on Yau on tafanam an tafa.”
On atonio dura iyau gibunai Iesu motobai ikan ato kanuai nan motob iyamai teteu imatar ato teteu ibo nan orot matan igos,
ato iyawur iyau, “Om enai Siloam una sareuai nan magim unsou.” (Atonio wab Siloam an yabin min, “Siyafarai inai.”) On mes orot inai magin isou, ato matan iyeit auman imatabir men inat.
On tuturan a sabu on ainau sit sabu auris i’kafefeyan ato osi tous wat sibitetem bonen si’yau, “Atonio orot kaitamom min on imair sabu auris i’kafefeyan i?”
Sabu fani siyau, “On orot are,” baise sabu fani siyau, “Ambin men on, ato atonio orot an itin min on ba.” On mes orot toun iyau, “Yau orot min atonio.”
Osi sitetemai siyau, “Om mamaba ufour ato matam uyeit i?”
On iyafotes iyau, “Orot Wabin seyoyorai Iesu on motob iyamai teteu imatar ato mataui igos, ato iyawureu atan Siloam nan magiu atsou. On mes Yau anai ato magiu asou mom on, yau matau iyeit.”
Osi sitetemai siyau, “On Orot min menan nan i?” On iyafotes iyau, “Yau men asagob.”
Pharisee Yangan Orot Iyayawas on Sinuen
Namon osi orot matan fotin on sibo sinai Pharisee yangan auris.
Ato on ra ato Iesu motob iyamai teteu imatar nan orot matan ibiyawasai min Sabat an ra nan.
Pharisee yangan on orot sitetemai men, mamaba matan iyeit aurin on. On iyawures iyau, “On teteu ibo mataui iyein weie magiu asou, ato ari matau ait.”

Pharisee yangan fani siyau, “Orot atonio bobo ifofour on men God emon on, yabin On Sabat an baifafaro aurin on men ifonabo on.” Baise sabu fani on siyau, “Orot bokomasotin on mamaba mes atonio osi bobo buburis on inafour i?” Ato osi tous wat sanasi on kuseseb imatar.
On mes Pharisee yangan on ra kaitamom ba orot sitetemai men siyau, “Om uyau on On om matam fotin on iyawasai, ato om On aurin on mamaba wat unau i?” On iyafotes iyau, “On aubairuruotin.”
Baise Jew babadis on men sigogoi sititutum on matan fotin ato ari on matan iyeit, on mes osi on fifi ayon taman siyores
ato sitetemis siyau, “Atonio fifi on omi natum i? Omi wau on matan fotin irat; ato mamaba mes on ari matan iyeit?”
Fifi ayon taman siyafotes siyau, “Wei wasagob on fifi on wei natui a wei wasagob on matan fotin irat.
Baise wei men wasagob on ari mamaba mes matam iyeit o wei men wasagob iyafan on matan iruseren. Omi toum woitetemai; on orot gagamin, on toun arimon awanai iniyafotem!”
On ayon taman atonio dura sikakafun yabin osi on Jew babadis auris siber, Jew babadis on sibasitai nono iyai iyafan dura inkurereb inau, Iesu on Keriso, on arimon bayoi goa emon sinrukou ingat.
On fasinai fifi ayon taman siyau, “Omi toum woitetemai, on orot gagamin!”
Wera bairuin orot matan fotin auman irarat on siyor men inat ato aurin siyau, “Om God matanai unaumatan on dura bag wat unikakafun! Wei wasagob atonio Orot ibiyawasim on bokomasotin.”
Orot iyafotes iyau, “Yau men asagob on orot on bokomasotin o ambin. Bobo kaitamom yau asagob on: Yau matau fotin on ari matau iyeit.”
Osi sitetemai siyau, “Om matam fotin aurin on abi bobo ifour?” On mamaba ifour matam iruseren i?”
On iyafotes iyau, “Yau ainau akasonem nono, ato omi dura men wotatam on. Omi aibo mes wogogoi dura wontatam men i? Tait, omi mat on wogogoi On an baigibubunuotim wonmatar bait?”
Osi on orot aurin dura komasis sikakafun ato siyau, “Om on ato Orot an baigibubunuotin; baise wei on Moses an baigibubunuoti.
Wei wasagob God on dura Moses aurin ikakafun; baise atonio Orot on wei men wasagob On men emon inat!”
Orot iyafotes iyau, “Yau on abiduduran kwakwan! Omi men wosagob On men emon inat, baise yau matau fotin on iyamai iyeit!
Ot tasagob God on men sabu bokomasotis fonas etatam on; On sabu ato osi iyabon On sekakafai a On an gogoi mamaba sefofour on fonas etatam.
Tafanam anai bag imamatar on men iyafan tani dura itatam on orot tani matan ifourai iyeit on.
Atonio Orot on men God emon ittananat on, On men bobo aifan tani nanaba itafour on.”
Osi siyafotai siyau, “Om urarat nenei on ari am bokomas on nana yen—ato om efofourtobon wei unibebeyei mes i?” Ato osi bayoi goa emon sirukou igat.
Ayuai Matan Ifot
Iesu dura itatam osi on orot sirukou igat. Iesu orot igaturai ato itetemai iyau, “Om min Orot Natun ebitutumai i?”
Orot iyafotai iyau, “Bada, ekasoneu On Orot min Iyafan, onai yau On anitutumai!”
Iesu on aurin iyau, “Om min ainau toum matamui ut nono, ato On min ari rum wobikakafun.”
Orot iyau, “Bada, yau abitutum, ato on Iesu nanai sindan irou.”
Iesu iyau, “Yau anat atonio tafanamai sabu anigurubabanis mes, onai sabu matas fotis on matas sineit a osi iyabon matas seit on matas sinafot.”
Pharisee yangan fani on nan atonio dura aifan ibikakafun on sitatam ato sitetemai siyau, “Om dura ebikakafun on wei mat min matai fotis i?”
Iesu iyafotes iyau, “Omi matam fotis mes on, arimon men wotbokomas; baise omi wau on matam siyeit, on an yabin min omi ami bokomas on nana sen.”
